cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 - defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 buffered by prominent Cocamidopropyl Betaine@4, no reinforcing strong anionic (settled SLES+betaine core). Coco-Glucoside@14 is post-E3.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: see rationale (counter-signals recorded there; convention value unchanged by claims, 3.2)

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: several light routes - a prominent humectant cluster (Urea@3, Glycerin@5, Panthenol@8), weak refatters (Glyceryl Oleate@13, Hydrogenated Palm Glycerides Citrate@18, Lecithin@19), pearlizer Glycol Distearate@15 and a post-E3 cationic guar@17. No early silicone or prominent payload lipid, so C2 is not met. Counter-signal: the only cationic is post-E3; low is the neighbor.

wLine.plausibility: (i) Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 before it; (ii) no cleansing surfactant, alkanolamide or pearlizing wax at 9-11

weightPotential.whyThisBand: Only light/late routes; humectants are context.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate (W2): the guar@17 is after Parfum and the pearlizer (trace), the second family is weak_refatter only, and there is no silicone, payload lipid or protein; an effective C1 chassis faces only light routes.
weightPotential.rationale: Low: late guar + weak refatters vs. C1 reset (6.6, W2).

focusPrimary.rationale: scalp_active: explicit dry/sensitive-scalp positioning with targeted comfort (7.2).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Targeted: SC1 met ('speziell für trockene sowie empfindliche Haut und Kopfhaut', manufacturer, moderate); CSA met by prominent E4 comfort routes Urea@3, Panthenol@8, Allantoin@9 and humectant routes Urea@3, Glycerin@5, Sodium Lactate@7, Panthenol@8. No cooling agent; cleansing moderate.

reconciliation: Projection: sensitive primary + dry secondary (both pass; S-PRIMARY order).

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 with weightPotential low (high, neighbor none) and conditioningLevel moderate (moderate, neighbor low): fine ideal, normal ideal, coarse acceptable. T6 scalp-concern floor (sensitive, dry): no not_suited fit to lift. T4: no neighbor yields a lower final tier. T2: thickness/volume claims ignored for fit.
projection.weightRationale: W-LIVE: weightPotential low -> weight light, 1:1; confidence = weightPotential confidence (high). Claims ('ohne zu beschweren', 'leicht') never lower it (6.5).

primary.rationale: S-SENSITIVE: E2 sensitive scalp in the manufacturer unit (moderate); formula gate targeted + prominent comfort route (Urea@3, Panthenol@8, Allantoin@9). S-PRIMARY: no target in the product name -> order sensitive, dry -> sensitive primary. Confidence moderate.

secondary.rationale: S-DRY: E2 dry scalp ('trockene ... Kopfhaut') in the same manufacturer unit (a unit naming two non-dandruff states counts for both, E2a); formula gate targeted + prominent humectant route Urea@3/Glycerin@5. Not dandruff-primary, not oily+dry. Confidence moderate.

projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1: cleansingStrength moderate (high), D1 false -> regular. I3: neighbor none raises no flag (irritationen expects gentle, trocken expects gentle).
projection.explicitResetRationale: No D1 stem (tiefenrein, deep clean, clarifying shampoo, detox-reinigung) in the name or a manufacturer/pack claim, and no occasional-use directions.
projection.deepCleanserRationale: D2 not met (cleansingStrength moderate, focusPrimary scalp_active, usageRole regular, D1 false) -> not_flagged.
projection.catalogDependent: review_live_value_differs not evaluated in-lane (live rows unseen; orchestrator after freeze).
